joined_baseline.runtime_path: Gemma4Attention -> QKVParallelLinear -> q/k/v split -> per-head norms/RoPE -> RadixAttention -> RowParallelLinear; full-attention K is duplicated into the runtime V shard.

decision.nominated_change: local KV heads 16 -> 8 in the 50 sliding-attention layers
decision.reason: It clears the 5% exact-work relevance screen with an established checkpoint-uptraining method. The global-dimension alternative clears only an optimistic 5.87% sum and lacks a comparably established modest conversion path after weak exact-weight retention.

candidates.change: local KV heads 16 -> 8; retain 32 query heads, head_dim=256, 50 layers, and 8192-wide O projection
candidates.mechanism: Halves local K/V projection rows, cache capacity, writes, and compulsory local paged-attention reads without deleting layers, MLP width, query heads, or residual width.

measured_anchored_work_relevance.limit: The sum is a relevance proxy. Grid underfill, overlap, cache hits, and noncritical work can prevent wall-time realization.

candidates.physical_risk: At an assumed 128-column CTA tile, c32 fused-QKV drops from 128 blocks (97.0% of one H200 SM wave) to 96 (72.7%); fixed/launch latency may erase projection savings.
candidates.falsifier: On the same H200 runtime, exact [32,5376,16384] vs [32,5376,12288] QKV and matched 16-vs-8-head paged-KV rows must reduce combined candidate boundary by >=5% of 0.363303 s/request; DRAM bytes should fall near the exact delta while achieved bandwidth and active-SM waves identify underfill.
candidates.post_training: Initialize each new K/V head by averaging adjacent old heads, distill teacher attention outputs/logits on the campaign prompt distribution, and uptrain before instruction tuning. Ainslie et al. establish GQA checkpoint conversion with 5% of original pretraining compute; this is a credible upper budget, not a Gemma-specific quality transfer.

prior_work.title: GQA: Training Generalized Multi-Query Transformer Models from Multi-Head Checkpoints
prior_work.source_backed_claim: Checkpoint uptraining to GQA can approach multi-head quality; the paper uses 5% of original pretraining compute.
prior_work.transfer_limit: The paper does not test Gemma 4, hybrid local/global attention, GPQA-Diamond, or TauBench.

candidates.quality_path: Gate perplexity/teacher-KL and 10K retrieval first; then paired exact served checkpoints on GPQA-Diamond and TauBench with raw tool-call traces, identical tokenizer/template/seed, bootstrap uncertainty, and no more than campaign-agreed degradation.

candidates.change: global head_dim 512 -> 256 in the ten full-attention layers; retain 32 query heads, 4 KV heads, K=V sharing, cadence, and all MLPs
candidates.mechanism: Halves global Q/K/V/O projection width and full-context KV bytes in only the long-range layers; targets HBM traffic that remains far beyond per-chip L2 at c32.

measured_anchored_work_relevance.limit: The sum is a relevance proxy. It omits attention arithmetic benefit but does not prove that removed work is on the endpoint critical path.

candidates.physical_risk: The assumed c32 QKV grid falls from 160 blocks over two H200 waves to 80 blocks in one 60.6%-occupied wave; the unusual 512-head global kernel is already source-specialized, so supported candidate dispatch must be proven.
candidates.falsifier: Exact [32,5376,20480]/[32,16384,5376] versus [32,5376,10240]/[32,8192,5376] linears plus 512-vs-256 full-context paged attention must save >=5% of 0.363303 s/request, with no fallback and measured DRAM bytes/SM waves.
candidates.post_training: Use one common learned 256-D projection per global KV group to initialize Q/K/V and the inverse O map, distill full-attention outputs and logits from the frozen teacher, then short continued pretraining and instruction tuning while local layers remain unchanged initially.
candidates.quality_path: Require 10K/long-context retrieval parity before the same paired exact-server GPQA-Diamond and TauBench protocol; inspect science-answer accuracy separately from tool selection, argument validity, and multi-turn completion.
candidates.rejection_reason: Only 5.87% on an optimistic linear-plus-ideal-HBM relevance sum, while sampled direct dimension selection retains 51.9-56.7% weight energy and no scope-matched modest checkpoint conversion is established. The active H200 profile should not spend a second arm on it.

rejected_nearby_changes: Shortening the 1024 local window: prior exact bound caps whole-request QK/AV relevance below 1.75% even at 256 tokens.
K=V global projection specialization alone: prior source-bound measured-row projection is 0.18-0.35% of the service ceiling.
Generic low rank or 2:4: prior exact sampled weights fail the preregistered structure/energy gates.
Changing 5:1 global cadence alone: it removes too little exact full-context work without also changing representational capacity.
